items.title: DF7CW: eight parks, all CW, on Sweden’s Kungsleden
items.blurb: Nils DF7CW’s guest write-up for Thomas Witherspoon is dated today: eight POTA parks along the arctic Kungsleden trail as SM/DF7CW, every QSO CW on 20 m with a Mountain Topper Currahee. A missing SOTABeams mast nearly ended the radio side until German hikers returned it at Alesjaure; inReach Mini spotted when cell died. Four ATFE parks, a swamp fourfer, and three hours of rain on a rough K-index day.

items.title: Two VK0 stations QRV from Australian Antarctica
items.blurb: WIA reminder: David Short VK2JDS is VK0DS at Davis (into late October; end-fed on a 22 m tower, V-beam planned, prior 2 m EME from Davis) while Tom Blunt VK2TBC is VK0TBC at Casey on SSB and FT8 around station duties. Two concurrent Australian Antarctic paths is uncommon — watch clusters and FT8, not a fixed DXpedition schedule.

items.title: XR0Z Selkirk: second cargo to Valparaíso, VHF gear for fishermen
items.blurb: Felipe XQ7IR and Moisés CE3VTZ update October’s Alexander Selkirk (SA-101) trip: Zoom with the park ranger and fishermen on moving gear from Robinson Crusoe; a second shipment of food and camping kit is headed to Valparaíso. They are donating a VHF marine antenna and 20 m of Belden 9913 to the fishing fleet. Still need a homebrew 6 m 3-el and more supplies; donations welcome.

items.title: JD1/JG1PFR Ogasawara CW trip postponed
items.blurb: Rudi DK7PE (JG1PFR) cancels the planned 12–19 September one-man CW week from Ogasawara after a serious family illness. Goal had been JD1/JG1PFR, wire antennas, no amp, ETM9c keyer, after the 26-hour Tokyo ship ride. He hopes to reschedule and will post a new date on rooody.de.

items.title: ANS-242: ARISS proposals open; ISS radios down for 1 Sep EVA
items.blurb: Today’s AMSAT weekly: ARISS wants school/org proposals for Jan–Jun 2027 crew contacts, due 30 September 23:59 PT. Board voting closes 15 September. Ops note: Columbus and Service Module radios power down 31 August for a 1 September USOS EVA, back up about 2 September 1155/1200Z; crossband repeater stays 145.990 up (PL 67) / 437.800 down when live.

items.title: V47YA and V47RCX St Kitts, 9–30 September
items.blurb: Tom K0YA as V47YA and Toni W5RCX as V47RCX will be QRV from St Kitts (QTH V47JA) 9–30 September, then again 3 February–3 March 2027. Holiday-style 160–6 m, CW, SSB, and FT8. QSL both via LoTW.

items.title: Cross-band HT on a budget: Retevis RA89R review
items.blurb: KB8WPD (Comms By Kemp Outside) posted this morning pointing at a dual-band Retevis RA89R review aimed at operators who want cross-band repeat without spending HT money twice. Handy field note if you are shopping rugged dual-band HTs for outdoor or EMCOM kits.
